# National Social Anxiety Center

> The National Social Anxiety Center (NSAC) is a leading organization providing evidence-based cognitive-behavioral therapy (CBT) treatment, educational resources, and clinical training for social anxiety disorder across multiple regional clinics.

NSAC operates a network of regional clinics specializing in CBT and anxiety treatment, offering both direct patient care and professional resources for mental health clinicians. The organization combines clinical services with educational content, research interviews, and self-assessment tools to support individuals with social anxiety and related disorders.

## Key Topics

- Cognitive-Behavioral Therapy (CBT)
- Social Anxiety Disorder
- Social Anxiety Treatment
- Exposure Therapy
- Anxiety Management
- Regional Clinics
- Therapist Directory
- Performance Anxiety
- Shame-Based Beliefs
- Mental Health Treatment
- CBT Sessions
- Social Anxiety Recovery
- Anxiety Disorders
- Clinician Resources

## Organization & Mission

- [National Social Anxiety Center - National Social Anxiety Center](https://nationalsocialanxietycenter.com): NSAC homepage featuring mission, leadership, and social anxiety treatment services
- [OUR MISSION - National Social Anxiety Center](https://nationalsocialanxietycenter.com/mission-and-endorsements): NSAC mission statement, organizational values, and board of directors

## Regional Clinics & Services

- [SOCIAL ANXIETY THERAPY BROOKLYN - National Social Anxiety Center](https://nationalsocialanxietycenter.com/regional-clinics/brooklynnyc): NSAC Brooklyn clinic information with Chamin Ajjan psychotherapy services
- [SOCIAL ANXIETY THERAPY PHOENIX - National Social Anxiety Center](https://nationalsocialanxietycenter.com/national-social-anxiety-center-phoenix): NSAC Phoenix clinic with Randy Weiss therapy services and CBT treatment
- [SOCIAL ANXIETY THERAPY LOS ANGELES - National Social Anxiety Center](https://nationalsocialanxietycenter.com/regional-clinics/los-angeles): NSAC Los Angeles clinic with Behavioral Associates LA offering CBT services
- [SOCIAL ANXIETY THERAPY LONG BEACH - National Social Anxiety Center](https://nationalsocialanxietycenter.com/regional-clinics/national-social-anxiety-center-long-beach): NSAC Long Beach clinic with Belmont Psychological Services for anxiety treatment
- [SOCIAL ANXIETY THERAPY SAN CLEMENTE / ORANGE COUNTY - National Social Anxiety Center](https://nationalsocialanxietycenter.com/regional-clinics/social-anxiety-therapy-bixby-knolls-ca): NSAC San Clemente/Orange County clinic with CBT and DBT services
- [SOCIAL ANXIETY THERAPY NEWPORT BEACH / ORANGE COUNTY - National Social Anxiety Center](https://nationalsocialanxietycenter.com/regional-clinics/newport-beach-orange-county): NSAC Newport Beach clinic with Anxiety & Depression Center services

## Treatment & Clinical Resources

- [WHAT IS SOCIAL ANXIETY? - National Social Anxiety Center](https://nationalsocialanxietycenter.com/social-anxiety): Educational guide defining social anxiety, triggers, and anxiety disorders
- [COGNITIVE-BEHAVIORAL THERAPY FOR SOCIAL ANXIETY - National Social Anxiety Center](https://nationalsocialanxietycenter.com/cognitive-behavioral-therapy): CBT overview and therapeutic strategies for social anxiety treatment
- [COGNITIVE-BEHAVIORAL THERAPY (CBT) FOR SOCIAL ANXIETY: SAMPLE SESSIONS - National Social Anxiety Center](https://nationalsocialanxietycenter.com/example-cbt-sessions): Sample CBT sessions with audio recordings demonstrating anxiety management
- [FOR CLINICIANS - National Social Anxiety Center](https://nationalsocialanxietycenter.com/for-clinicians): Professional resources and workshops for mental health clinicians

## Assessment & Self-Help Tools

- [FREE SELF-SCORING SOCIAL ANXIETY QUESTIONNAIRE](https://nationalsocialanxietycenter.com/liebowitz-sa-scale): Free Liebowitz Social Anxiety Scale self-assessment tool for anxiety measurement

## Stories, Interviews & Learning

- [PERSONAL STORIES - National Social Anxiety Center](https://nationalsocialanxietycenter.com/personal-stories): Client testimonials and recovery stories from CBT therapy outcomes
- [57-year-old white lesbian; District of Columbia(audio story) - National Social Anxiety Center](https://nationalsocialanxietycenter.com/57-year-old-white-lesbian-washington-dc): Audio testimonial of social anxiety recovery in Washington DC clinic
- [Targeting Shame-Based Beliefs in CBT for Social Anxiety | NSAC](https://nationalsocialanxietycenter.com/interviews-with-social-anxiety-researchers/targeting-shame-based-beliefs-in-cbt-social-anxiety): Interview with Larry Cohen on shame-based beliefs in CBT treatment
- [BLOG - National Social Anxiety Center](https://nationalsocialanxietycenter.com/blog): Blog archive covering selective mutism, childhood anxiety, and mental health

## Reference Materials
